newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Parliament's upper chamber, the Senate, resumed its session on Monday to debate a bill on the restitution of buildings formerly owned by the Jewish Community in Romania.

* Romania's foreign ministry hosted the first trilateral meeting of Ukrainian, Moldovan and Romanian ministers aimed at setting a regional programme to boost economic exchanges between the three countries.
A trilateral summit is due in Ukraine on July 3.

* A U.S. decision to back only Hungary, Poland and the Czech Republic in the first wave of NATO estward expansion was seen as an injustice by Romanians, as the country met terms for entry in the military partnership, Romanian Defence Minister Victor Babiuc said during a visit to Lisbon.
He said Romania still hoped the United States would change its position and include the Balkan country in the alliance's expansion.
* A delegation of the Romanian Senate, led by chairman Petre Roman, has started a visit to Paris to attend a French-Romanian economic forum.
Roman is expected to meet President Jacques Chirac.

* Coalminers in the Jiu valley continued their strike over pay demands. A miners' delegation has started talks with government representatives, including the finance, industry, health and labour ministers.

* Workers at the state-run Roman SA truck maker protest over the company's restructuring and privatisation programme. They locked the factory gates and ordered the press out. A news conference of union leaders is expected later in the day.
